title: Music beds
summary: Background music beds. None ship with the project: add your own. Put an mp3 you have the right to use in this folder and add an entry here ({"id", "file", "seconds", "beatAt", "mood"}). Then set one per storyboard: "music": {"name": "<id>", "start": 13, "gain": -12, "duck": 7}. start = seconds into the track (skip the intro: use the item's beatAt), gain = dB against the speaking level, duck = dB it dips during speech.
